note: Genre-specific DoD sections are additive — they append additional checklist items to the base dod_template.json. Present the relevant genre section to the developer after they select their genre during ingest. Items here follow the same DoDItem schema: key, description. Priority (V1/V2/N/A) and riskLevel are assigned by the developer during ingest.

genres.label: Platformer / Action-Platformer
genres.description: Side-scrolling or 2D/3D platformers where precise movement and jumping are the primary mechanic.

items.description: Coyote time implemented — player can jump briefly after walking off a ledge
Jump buffering implemented — jump input registers when pressed slightly before landing
Jump arc, height, and gravity tuned to feel responsive and fair
Variable jump height (hold to jump higher) implemented correctly (if applicable)
Wall jump, wall grab, or wall slide works consistently (if applicable)
Double jump or air jump works correctly and feels intentional (if applicable)
Moving platform interactions correct — player moves with platform, no clipping
Collision detection accurate at all movement speeds — no tunneling through terrain
Camera follows player smoothly without jarring snaps or boundary clipping
Camera provides adequate look-ahead in the direction of travel (if applicable)
Death zones (pits, spikes, hazards) trigger correctly and consistently
Respawn/checkpoint placement is fair — player can see what killed them
Death animation and respawn flow are clear and do not block input
Coyote time (grace period after walking off a ledge) tuned and consistent — player does not feel cheated
Jump input buffering implemented — jump queued slightly before landing registers correctly
Variable jump height works correctly — releasing jump early produces a shorter arc (if applicable)
Wall sliding, wall jumping, or ledge grabbing behave consistently on all geometry (if applicable)
Collision detection is pixel-accurate or logically consistent — no invisible walls, no clipping through thin platforms
One-way / drop-through platforms work in all directions — player can fall through intentionally, not accidentally
Moving platforms carry the player correctly — no jitter, no being pushed through geometry
Camera tracks the player smoothly — no jarring snaps, and look-ahead anticipates movement direction
Respawn / checkpoint placement is fair — player can see what killed them before respawning into the same hazard
All death types (pit, enemy, hazard, crush) trigger the correct death animation, sound, and respawn flow
Level exit / goal is clearly communicated visually — player knows where to go without a guide
Collectibles tracked per level and globally — completion percentage accurate (if applicable)
Depth cues in 3D platformers clearly communicate platform position — shadow blobs or drop indicators present (if 3D)

genres.label: Puzzle
genres.description: Games where solving logic, spatial, or mechanical puzzles is the primary activity.

items.description: Every puzzle is solvable without external help or guides
No puzzle can reach a permanently unsolvable state through normal player actions
Puzzle reset or undo function works correctly and returns to a valid state
No pixel-hunting or unintuitive object interactions required to progress
Solutions are discoverable but not trivially obvious — difficulty curve verified through playtesting
Hint system or contextual help available for stuck players (if applicable)
Puzzle types are varied enough to avoid feeling repetitive across the full game
Clear feedback when a puzzle is solved — audio, visual, or both
Clear feedback when a wrong action is taken — player understands why it failed
Puzzle elements are visually distinct and readable — player can identify interactive objects
Every puzzle has been independently verified as solvable — by a tester who did not design it
Intended solution path verified — unintended alternate solutions are accepted, blocked, or flagged as intentional
Undo history depth is sufficient for the complexity of the puzzle — does not run out mid-puzzle (if applicable)
Hint system provides useful nudges without spoiling the solution — and does not trigger accidentally (if applicable)
Option to skip or bypass puzzles available for players who are stuck — with an appropriate cost or unlock (if applicable)
Puzzle state saves correctly mid-puzzle — player does not lose progress on quit or crash
Player receives clear feedback when a puzzle is solved — distinct audio, visual, and progression signal
Puzzle mechanics are internally consistent — what works in one puzzle works the same way in all puzzles using that mechanic
Tutorial puzzles teach mechanics in isolation before combining them — no mechanic first appears in a multi-mechanic context
Puzzle difficulty ramps reviewed — no sudden spikes that require external walkthroughs to overcome

genres.label: Roguelite / Roguelike
genres.description: Games with procedurally generated runs, permadeath (or softdeath), and persistent meta-progression.

items.description: Run start, play, death, and return-to-hub loop complete and smooth
Typical run length is tuned — not too short to feel meaningless, not too long to feel punishing
Run variety is sufficient — no single dominant strategy trivializes all runs
No game-breaking item / ability combination bugs in any achievable combination
Seeded run system produces consistent results for same seed (if applicable)
Meta-progression (unlocks, currency, permanent upgrades) persists correctly between runs
Unlock tracking is accurate — no double-unlocks or phantom locks
Prestige / meta-reset function works correctly and only resets what it should (if applicable)
Death screen displays meaningful run stats — time, score, progress reached
Player can see what they are working toward unlocking (if applicable)
Seeds produce identical runs reliably — same seed = same layout, enemies, and loot every time (if seeded)
All procedurally generated layouts are solvable — no generated runs with unreachable exits or required items
Permadeath consequence is clearly communicated before the first run — no surprise save deletion
Mid-run progress saved correctly on quit — player can resume an in-progress run (if run-resume is supported)
Meta-progression unlocks (permanent upgrades, characters, items) save correctly and accumulate between runs
Unlock progression reviewed — early unlocks are accessible to new players, late unlocks require meaningful effort
Item / relic / build synergies tested — no synergy combination crashes the game or produces infinite loops
Item pool weighted correctly — overpowered items are appropriately rare, underpowered items reviewed or removed
Sufficient item, enemy, and layout variety to make runs feel distinct after 10+ hours of play
Boss difficulty scales appropriately with run depth or floor — not trivial on early floors or impossible on final
Average run length tested and within design target — not so short it feels trivial, not so long it becomes exhausting
Player can abandon a run cleanly at any point — no forced softlock when a run is clearly lost
End-of-run stats / summary screen shows meaningful data — kills, damage, items found, time (if applicable)
Daily challenge / seeded run mode fully functional and produces fair, consistent seeds (if applicable)

genres.label: RPG / Adventure
genres.description: Role-playing and adventure games with quests, characters, dialogue, and often inventory or progression systems.

items.description: All main story path quests completable from start to finish without workarounds
No quest can be permanently failed without explicit notification to the player
All shipped side quests completable without errors or dead ends (if applicable)
All dialogue trees reach a conclusion — no orphaned or dead-end nodes
Quest tracker accurately reflects current objectives at all times
Inventory management functional at and beyond capacity limits — no crashes or data loss
All player abilities, skills, and spells function as described
NPC AI and pathfinding work correctly — NPCs do not get stuck or behave erratically
Map and waypoint system is accurate and guides player correctly (if applicable)
Save compatibility verified across all major story stages — no broken saves mid-quest
All stat calculations are accurate — damage, defense, crit, evasion formulas produce the stated results
Level / experience curve reviewed and tested — no degenerate grind walls or trivial power jumps
Skill tree / ability system fully functional — no dead nodes, orphaned skills, or UI inconsistencies
Equipment compare, equip, unequip, and drop systems work without data loss or stat errors
Inventory limit behavior is clear and graceful — player cannot lose items to overflow silently
Quest log accurately reflects all active, completed, and failed quests — no stale entries
Branching dialogue trees have been fully traversed in testing — no dead ends or repeated lines
Faction / reputation system correctly tracks player choices and reflects them in NPC dialogue and behavior (if applicable)
World state changes from major decisions are saved and persist correctly — NPCs remember player actions
Economy balance reviewed — player is neither perpetually broke nor drowning in currency by midgame
Shop / merchant UI works correctly — buying, selling, buying back, and stock refresh all function as designed
All combat encounters playtested at expected player level — no unwinnable encounters in critical path
All status effects (poison, stun, burn, freeze, etc.) apply, stack, and expire correctly
Companion AI makes reasonable decisions in combat and exploration (if applicable) — not suicidally dumb or broken
Post-game / NG+ / endgame content functions correctly and credits play before unlocking (if applicable)

genres.label: Visual Novel / Narrative
genres.description: Story-driven games where reading dialogue, making choices, and experiencing narrative are the primary activities.

items.description: All routes, paths, and endings are reachable through normal play
All endings are complete — no truncated or placeholder endings
No branching dead-ends, orphaned dialogue nodes, or infinite loops
Endings / route completion tracked correctly in records or gallery (if applicable)
True end or secret ending gating logic works correctly (if applicable)
Save at any dialogue point works correctly and restores accurately
Dialogue log / backlog is scrollable, accurate, and does not overflow
Auto-advance (auto-play) function works correctly at a readable speed
Skip function (skip seen text) works correctly and stops at choices and unseen content
CG / scene gallery unlocks correctly and is accessible from main menu (if applicable)
All dialogue lines have voice audio — no missing or silent lines (if voice acted)
All dialogue lines written, proofread, and implemented — no missing or placeholder text in any route
All story routes and endings reachable and tested — no orphaned flags or unreachable endings
Player choices produce the correct narrative outcomes — no choice routes to the wrong ending
Skip (fast-forward) function works correctly — stops at unread text or choices for the current playthrough
Auto-advance mode advances text at a readable pace and pauses on choices (if applicable)
Dialogue backlog is available and scrollable — allows player to re-read recent lines
CG gallery / scene gallery unlocks correctly as scenes are encountered — no premature or missed unlocks (if applicable)
Music / sound room unlocks correctly as tracks are heard in-game (if applicable)
Chapter select or flowchart allows players to replay specific scenes (if applicable)
Voiced line timing matches dialogue box text — no lines finishing before text ends or vice versa (if voice acted)
Content warnings for mature themes (violence, abuse, mental health, sexual content) displayed before affected scenes
All endings (good, bad, true, route) verified accessible and flagged in save data or gallery (if applicable)

genres.label: Survival / Crafting
genres.description: Games where resource gathering, crafting, base building, and survival mechanics are central.

items.description: All crafting recipes functional and producing correct output items
Resource respawn / regeneration works correctly and at the intended rate
Inventory-full state handled gracefully — no data loss, no silent item drops
Crafting UI clearly shows required materials and what is missing
Full world state persists correctly between sessions — no state loss on load
Day / night cycle integrates correctly with gameplay systems (if applicable)
Base building placement and collision work correctly — no overlap bugs (if applicable)
Hunger, thirst, health decay, or other survival meters are balanced and clearly communicated
Death penalty (item loss, respawn point, etc.) is clearly communicated before death
Player needs (hunger, thirst, temperature, stamina) are clearly communicated — player always knows their status
Death from needs depletion is signaled clearly in advance — player has meaningful opportunity to respond
Inventory weight or space limits are communicated and enforced fairly — no silent item loss
Crafting UI clearly shows required ingredients, quantities, and what will be produced — no mystery recipes
Recipe discovery system works correctly — unlocking a recipe adds it to the list immediately and persistently
Base building placement snaps correctly, handles terrain, and cannot produce unreachable or broken structures (if applicable)
Player-built structures persist correctly across sessions and world chunk loads
World generation produces no unreachable critical resources, broken biome transitions, or degenerate spawn locations
Day/night cycle transitions correctly — lighting, enemy spawns, and temperature changes fire at correct times
Death respawn options clearly presented — respawn at bed, world spawn, or fresh start — with loot recovery rules explained
Item durability / degradation communicated clearly — player warned before critical tool breaks mid-task (if applicable)
World map updates as the player explores — no permanently blank regions in the explored area
Chunk/zone loading is smooth — no pop-in of enemies or resources within visible range

genres.label: Shooter (2D / 3D)
genres.description: Games where aiming, shooting, and combat with ranged weapons are the primary mechanic.

items.description: Hit detection accurate across all weapon types, angles, and movement speeds
Projectile / bullet pooling implemented — no memory leak under sustained fire
Reticle or crosshair accurately reflects actual hit detection area
Ammo and reload system complete — no edge cases that allow infinite ammo or lock reload
Weapon switching works correctly — no state confusion between weapons
Damage numbers, hit flash, or equivalent feedback visible and accurate (if applicable)
Enemy AI pathfinding and attack patterns work correctly in all map areas
Enemy difficulty tuned across all difficulty settings (if applicable)
Hitscan and projectile weapons behave consistently with their described mechanics
Mouse sensitivity range is wide enough to accommodate low-sens and high-sens players — persists across sessions
Mouse smoothing/acceleration toggle available — competitive players expect this to be off by default
Field of view slider available and applies correctly — range covers at least 60–110 degrees
Aim assist tuned appropriately for controller players — toggleable and clearly labeled
Crosshair is accurate to actual shot dispersion — does not mislead the player about hit likelihood
Hit registration is accurate and consistent — no phantom misses or hits at expected ranges
Every weapon has distinct audio, visual recoil, and screen feedback — player always knows a shot fired
Reload animations and timings are accurate — ammo count updates at the correct frame, not before/after
Ammo UI clearly shows current magazine / reserve — no ambiguity between mag and total ammo
Head bobbing toggle available — motion sickness mitigation for FPS games
Weapon model does not clip into geometry when the player stands close to walls or corners
Enemy AI nav mesh covers all walkable areas — no enemies getting stuck or pathing into walls
Cover mechanics work correctly — player snaps in and out cleanly, no stuck states (if applicable)
Directional damage indicators clearly show incoming damage direction (if applicable)

genres.label: Horror
genres.description: Games where atmosphere, tension, fear, and psychological or action-horror experiences are the primary focus.

items.description: Lighting and darkness rendering correct — no unintended light bleed or fully black areas
Sound design tested for intended scare factor — no accidental comedy from audio bugs
Atmosphere and tension maintained throughout — no unintentional immersion breaks
No horror section trivializable due to a bug, exploit, or AI failure
Jump scare timing consistent across playthroughs — not exploitable or skippable
Enemy AI unpredictability verified across multiple playthroughs — no obvious pattern exploitation
Sanity, fear, or psychological mechanics functional and tuned (if applicable)
Safe rooms, hiding spots, or sanctuary mechanics function correctly (if applicable)
Photosensitivity warning displayed prominently at launch — flashing lights, strobes, or flickering effects present
Brightness calibration screen present — game is playable in dark scenes without being trivially lit
All horror cues (jump scare audio, ambient tension, monster sounds) tested on headphones and speakers — impact not lost
Enemy AI behavior is consistent — players can learn and predict it through observation, not memorization of random patterns
Checkpoint placement is fair — players do not lose more than 2–3 minutes of progress to any single death
Resource scarcity (ammo, healing) balanced — player can complete the game without perfect play but must ration carefully
Content warnings for gore, body horror, psychological distress, and mature themes displayed before the game begins
Option to reduce or disable specific graphic content (gore toggle, jump scare intensity) where feasible (if applicable)
Jump scares are not placed at save points, unavoidable corridors, or load screens — they reward player attention
Inventory management UI is accessible quickly under pressure — slow or clunky menus reviewed for tension balance

genres.label: Strategy / Tower Defense
genres.description: Games where planning, resource management, unit control, and tactical decisions are the primary mechanic.

items.description: All unit and tower types fully functional with correct stats and behaviors
Pathfinding AI works correctly at maximum unit count — no lag or routing failures
Resource generation, spending, and economy balanced and correctly implemented
Win and loss conditions trigger reliably and correctly in all scenarios
UI displays all relevant strategic information at all times — no hidden or inaccessible data
Performance tested and acceptable at maximum possible entity count
No single dominant strategy trivializes all scenarios at any difficulty
Difficulty settings produce meaningfully different challenges (if applicable)
AI difficulty levels tested and accurately labeled — Easy AI is beatable by new players, Hard AI provides a challenge
AI cheating (resource bonuses, fog-of-war omniscience) is disclosed or eliminated — no invisible unfair advantages on lower difficulties
Fog of war reveals and conceals correctly — no enemy units visible before scouting (if applicable)
Resource economy playtested at all difficulty levels — no degenerate opening strategies that trivialize the game
Unit pathfinding avoids obstacles and does not get stuck — tested in tight choke points and crowded maps
Strategy UI conveys all necessary information — resource counts, unit stats, territory control clearly readable at a glance
Tooltips on all units, buildings, abilities, and resources are accurate and complete
Undo or 'move preview' available to prevent accidental unit moves or build placements (if applicable)
Mid-mission save / load available for long-form strategy missions (if applicable)
Tech tree / research tree fully implemented — no orphaned nodes, all prerequisites enforced correctly (if applicable)
All win and loss conditions trigger correctly — timed wins, domination, elimination, economic victory all tested
Map variety reviewed — no single dominant opening strategy that trivializes all maps (if applicable)
Performance acceptable in late-game scenarios with maximum units, buildings, and effects on screen simultaneously

genres.label: Sports / Racing
genres.description: Competitive sports or racing games where physics, timing, and opponent AI define the experience.

items.description: Physics feel consistent and fair across all surfaces, conditions, and vehicles
Track, arena, and boundary collision correct — no shortcuts or out-of-bounds exploits
All playable vehicles, characters, or teams balanced and tuned
Physics edge cases tested — no game-breaking flips, clips, or stuck states
Timer and scoring system accurate — no floating point drift or rounding errors
AI opponents tuned across all difficulty settings — not impossible, not trivial
Replay or ghost system functional and accurate (if applicable)
Leaderboard or high score table functions correctly and persists (if applicable)
Vehicle physics are consistent — same inputs produce the same outputs on the same surface every time
Vehicle collision is fair — players are not unfairly penalized for being hit by AI or other players
AI rubber-banding behavior disclosed or removed — AI does not teleport to stay close to the player
Lap counter and position tracker are accurate at all times — no wrong lap counts or position jumps
Off-track shortcuts ruled on — either blocked, allowed, or penalized consistently
Finish line detection is accurate — no false triggers or missed crossings
Ghost / replay system records and plays back correctly without desyncing (if applicable)
Force feedback rumble tuned appropriately — not overpowering, communicates road feel and collisions (if applicable)
Time trial / best lap time saving and display works correctly — times persist across sessions

genres.label: Incremental / Idle
genres.description: Games where automated resource generation, exponential progression, and long-session loop design are central — increasingly dominant on Steam and mobile.

items.description: Core increment loop works correctly — resources generate over time at the correct rate
Offline progression calculates correctly on return — no overcounting or undercounting
Offline progress is communicated clearly to the player on return
All upgrades and purchased improvements function as described with correct effect
Upgrade stacking and interactions produce correct compounded results — no formula errors
Numbers format correctly at very large values — 1K, 1M, 1B, scientific notation, etc.
No integer or float overflow at achievable max values — tested at endgame progression
No negative resource values possible from any combination of offline time or upgrades
Prestige / ascension reset function resets exactly what it should — no data bleed (if applicable)
Prestige benefit is clearly communicated before committing to the reset (if applicable)
Performance acceptable at maximum upgrade count — no frame drops from calculation load
Autosave frequency appropriate for game speed — progress not lost on unexpected close
Game does not consume excessive CPU/GPU resources while idle or minimized
Major progression milestones have clear feedback — player knows when something significant unlocked

genres.label: Metroidvania
genres.description: Games with ability-gated exploration, interconnected maps, and backtracking as a core progression mechanic.

items.description: All ability-gated areas are correctly locked before the ability is acquired and correctly accessible after
Known sequence breaks tested — either blocked, accepted as intended, or flagged as out-of-scope bugs
Map accurately reflects explored and unexplored areas — all rooms present, no phantom rooms or missing rooms
Player can place custom markers or pins on the map to flag unexplored paths (if applicable)
Backtracking to previously blocked areas is intuitive — new ability clearly suggests where to use it
Fast travel system works correctly — all available stations reachable from all other stations (if applicable)
Upgrade / collectible tracking is accurate — map or menu shows what has been collected in each area
100% completion is achievable without missable items — or missable items are clearly documented in-game
Defeated bosses do not respawn and block progression unless by design — boss rooms are revisitable safely
Shortcuts and doors unlocked by progression remain unlocked after load/save — no re-locking bugs

genres.label: Deck Builder / Card Game
genres.description: Games where building, managing, and playing from a card deck is the primary mechanic.

items.description: Deck shuffle is truly randomized — no detectable patterns, seeded reproducibly (if seed-based)
Draw mechanics are accurate — correct number of cards drawn, no duplicate draws from a single-copy deck
All card interaction combinations tested — no edge-case combinations crash the game or produce invalid states
Discard pile, exile, and hand interactions all function correctly — cards do not disappear or duplicate
Buffs, debuffs, and persistent effects apply, stack, and expire correctly across turns
Card text is readable at all supported resolutions — all keywords have tooltips
Card draw, play, and discard animations are skippable for players who want faster gameplay
Card collection, deck editor, and filter UI are functional and usable with all input methods (if applicable)
Win/loss triggers fire correctly — no premature game-over from card effects, no infinite loops from self-triggering effects

genres.label: Fighting / Sports
genres.description: Games where direct combat, frame-precise inputs, hitbox accuracy, and competitive balance are the primary mechanic.

items.description: Frame data for all moves is accurate and consistent — startup, active, and recovery frames match the stated design
Hitboxes and hurtboxes accurately match character visuals — no invisible hits or unfair whiffs
Combo system registers inputs correctly — no dropped inputs in fast sequences on all supported controllers
In-game move list / command list is accurate and complete — all moves documented
AI difficulty levels tested — easy AI is genuinely learnable, hard AI is challenging but fair
Score, points, and win condition tracking is accurate — no incorrect point awards or missed triggers
Match replay system records and plays back accurately — correct frame-for-frame reproducibility (if applicable)
Netcode type documented (rollback, delay-based) and latency tolerance tested at documented max ping (if online)
Training / practice mode works correctly — hitbox display, frame data overlay, reset options all functional (if applicable)
